blog_title: DTF Print on Polyester vs Cotton — Why ₹30K Order Bubbled in Rain (Monsoon Printing Guide)
caption:
₹30k order destroyed in one monsoon rain 😬

A printer chose ₹45 polyester for DTF prints. First downpour? Color bleeding and bubbling everywhere. We tested it: cotton absorbs moisture so ink stays locked in. Polyester repels water, lifting the print right off.

200 GSM cotton + DTF = monsoon-safe. Test your fabric before bulk orders start.

Save this if you're sourcing blanks for rainy season 👇
